Hi everyone.

I'd like to introduce myself; a clinical research pharmacist interested in transitioning into clinical pharmacology and pharmacometrics. Since graduating from pharmacy school in 2021, I've gone on to develop my clinical practice experience through a PGY-1 residency and stints at some great institutions, including Memorial Sloan Kettering. In between all these opportunities, the allure of quantitative clinical pharmacology and drug development intrigued and led me to complete my Master's in Pharmacometrics and Personalized Pharmacotherapy at the University at Buffalo School of Pharmacy and Pharmaceutical Sciences.

As if residency wasn't hard enough, these last two years were challenging to say the least, but my grass couldn't be any greener. I have learned so much about model-informed drug development and the complex intersection of mathematics, statistics, coding, and pharmaceutical sciences that is pharmacometrics. It was my utmost pleasure to learn from the giants in our field (to name a few Dr. Mager, Dr. Jusko, Dr. Bies, and so on) and become a symbolic extension of their knowledge and expertise.

In an attempt to weather the storm of a poor economy for entry-level pharmacometricians/clinical pharmacologists, I hope to continually improve my skills and knowledge whilst presenting my findings to any who are interested enough to read my babble in all my later posts.
